transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... work, mostly. I'm a translator, and... well, for months now, I've just been seeing this same pattern in the project files. 

Certain subcontractors... and one colleague in particular... they keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory. And the timestamps. It's... it's being done so it looks like my quality control failed. I mean, IT says the audit trail is clean, but... I know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. So... I guess that's why I'm here.
Can you tell me more about why you believe someone is trying to frame you? Have you noticed any other instances outside of work where you feel someone is targeting you or trying to harm you?
I don't... I mean, it's just at work. It's the files. I haven't noticed anything else, no. Just... the translations. That's all.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to understand, such as thinking that someone is putting thoughts in your mind or controlling your actions?
No. I don't... I don't have thoughts like that. Nobody is putting things in my head. It's just... the files at work. That's all.
Have you ever had any beliefs that others might not share or understand, such as feeling that something has special meaning for you alone, even if it doesn’t seem to make sense logically?
No... no, nothing like that. I don't... I don't see special meanings in things. I just see what's actually there. In the files. I'm not... I'm not imagining things, if that's what you mean.
Do you believe, without any doubt, that these changes to the files are being made intentionally to frame you, even if others don’t see the same evidence?

Yes. I mean... I wouldn't say it if I wasn't sure. For months now, I’ve been seeing the exact same pattern in the project files. It's... certain subcontractors. And one colleague. They keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory. And the timestamps. Just enough so it looks like my quality control failed. 

I know IT says the audit trail is clean... but I know what I'm looking at. The record has been arranged to put the blame on me. So... yes. I don't have any doubt about it.

latest_inference.note: The patient's belief is non-bizarre and circumscribed, focused on a specific situation (work-related framing) without generalization to other areas, presence of other delusional themes, or hallucinations. This makes F22.0 (Delusional disorder) the most likely candidate. Other candidates such as F20.0 (Schizophrenia), F23.0 (Acute polymorphic psychotic disorder), F31.2 (Bipolar disorder, current episode manic without psychotic symptoms), F32.2 (Major depressive episode with severe depressive episode), and F43.22 (Adjustment disorder with depressed mood) are ruled out due to absence of respective core symptoms.

inference_history.note: Initial presentation suggests possible delusional themes (persecutory) related to work, leading to a broad list of differentials including delusional disorder, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder with psychotic features, and adjustment disorder with anxiety/depressed mood.
